the_defect_this_gate_found_in_its_own_fi.the_fix: classify by meaning with a declared reason per table. The name matcher survives only as review_hint_columns, documented as a review aid and never a gate.
the_defect_this_gate_found_in_its_own_fi.the_shape_of_the_mistake: substring versus meaning - the defect class this campaign has now hit about eighteen times, committed here by the tool built to prevent an information leak
the_defect_this_gate_found_in_its_own_fi.what: the table classifier matched column NAMES against a list of unsafe words including `state`
the_defect_this_gate_found_in_its_own_fi.why_both_are_false_positives: both are row lifecycle states. The word also names an OAuth state, and a name-matching scan cannot tell them apart.

infrastructure_path.question: can the provider dump and restore a database?
infrastructure_path.why: no managed instance exists. Every substantive check is SKIP and has been since it was written.

why_the_data_path_is_worth_having_on_its: a provider dump proves bytes survive a round trip. It proves nothing about whether a digest still hashes, an intent still resolves, or an archived row still reads - which is what a restore has to be good for.
